description: This Java class, DefaultStreamStageConfig, provides configuration for a stream processing stage, including parameters like parallelism and backoff strategies. It implements the StreamStageConfig interface and offers methods to instantiate and retrieve its settings.

classes.name: DefaultStreamStageConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing StreamStageConfig, encapsulating parallelism and exponential backoff configuration for a stream processing stage.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultStreamStageConfig based on provided Config object and config path.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the configured level of parallelism for the stream stage.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the backoff configuration used for stream retries.
